entries.content: Keeper Orrin tends the harbor lighthouse. He is gruff with strangers and kind to anyone lost at sea.

The drowned bell hangs in the flooded chapel beneath the harbor. Its rope rots but never breaks.
[History]
It rang the night the sea wall broke, and the lighthouse has stayed dark since it went quiet.
[Rules]
Only a keeper of the lighthouse may ring it, and only at low tide.
Anyone else who pulls the rope hears the drowned call their name.
[Rumors]
Fishers say the bell rings by itself before a storm.
Saltmarsh Road runs from the harbor to the village. It floods at dusk on spring tides.
The ferry costs two copper bits a head, and a keeper rides free.
